details.question: 各城市的销售额是多少？按销售额从高到低排序
details.sql:
SELECT c.city, ROUND(SUM(oi.amount), 2) AS sales_amount
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成')
GROUP BY c.city
ORDER BY sales_amount DESC

details.question: 各品类的销售额是多少？

FROM order_items oi

JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成')
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY sales_amount DESC

details.question: 2026年各月的销售额趋势
details.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(oi.amount), 2) AS sales_amount
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成')
  AND o.order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month
